art_note: The imagery relies on marketplace templates and flattened digital composites, lacking the refined aesthetics of a luxury fashion house.
desc_en: A fluid silhouette tailored for contemporary elegance. This sleeveless midi dress features a flattering V-shaped neckline and an elastic waistband that delicately defines the silhouette. Front pockets introduce discreet functionality to the piece. Crafted from a subtly textured fabric, it offers a lightweight drape and effortless comfort. A versatile garment designed to transition seamlessly between refined daytime occasions and relaxed evenings.
desc_es: Una silueta fluida diseñada para la elegancia contemporánea. Este vestido midi sin mangas presenta un favorecedor escote en V y una cintura elástica que define sutilmente la figura. Los bolsillos frontales aportan una funcionalidad discreta a la pieza. Confeccionado en un tejido sutilmente texturizado, ofrece una caída ligera y un confort absoluto. Una prenda versátil para transicionar sin esfuerzo entre ocasiones formales y momentos de descanso.
